enfin.name: EnFin
enfin.scope_note: Solar TPO (lease/PPA) only. Owned by Hanwha, the same parent as Qcells - Q Cell modules only, no exceptions. Soft credit pull that converts to a hard pull at NTP Funding. rows.note: Tolerance = how far the final installed design may differ from the SIGNED contract before a customer re-sign is required. It is NOT the utility offset. Utility offset (production vs usage) is a separate, state-specific cap - see State Guidelines: CT true cap is 105% (Trinity designs to 103% as a safety margin), and CT allows a 5-year lookback to the highest 12-month usage - so push a deal that is modestly over unless the utility has actually rejected it; PA, NY, MA, MD 110% (a signed deal one panel over 110% can be pushed with no change order); OH 120%; RI 125%; NJ 100% by utility. CT can also exceed via an internal load calc plus a signed MOU carrying an EV or Heat-Pump adder.
